nodes.name: Add ClubSpark Package Import Item Webhook

parameters.jsCode:
const sqlLiteral = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
};
const sqlInteger = (value) => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'NULL';
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(String(value), 10);
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) ? String(parsed) : 'NULL';
};
const item = $input.first()?.json ?? {};
return [{
  json: {
    sql: `WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    ${sqlInteger(item.batch_id)}::bigint AS requested_batch_id,
    ${sqlInteger(item.member_id)}::bigint AS requested_member_id,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.member)}::text AS member_name,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.membership)}::text AS source_membership_hint,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.email_address)}::text AS email_address_hint,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.target_membership)}::text AS target_membership,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.notes)}::text AS notes,
    ${sqlLiteral(item.created_by)}::text AS created_by
), resolved_batch AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      p.requested_batch_id,
      (SELECT b.id FROM public.signup_batches b WHERE b.status = 'Processing' ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT 1)
    ) AS batch_id,
    p.requested_batch_id
  FROM params p
), candidate_member AS (
  SELECT
    rm.id AS raw_member_id,
    trim(concat_ws(' ', rm."First name", rm."Last name")) AS member_name,
    NULLIF(trim(rm."Email address"), '') AS email_address,
    rm."Membership" AS source_membership,
    rm."Status" AS member_status,
    rm."Payment" AS member_payment_status
  FROM public.raw_members rm
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE COALESCE(rm.is_current, true) = true
    AND (
      (p.requested_member_id IS NOT NULL AND rm.id = p.requested_member_id)
      OR (
        p.requested_member_id IS NULL
        AND p.member_name IS NOT NULL
        AND p.member_name <> ''
        AND lower(trim(concat_ws(' ', rm."First name", rm."Last name"))) = lower(trim(p.member_name))
        AND (p.source_membership_hint IS NULL OR p.source_membership_hint = '' OR rm."Membership" = p.source_membership_hint)
      )
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p.requested_member_id IS NOT NULL AND rm.id = p.requested_member_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    CASE WHEN p.source_membership_hint IS NOT NULL AND p.source_membership_hint <> '' AND rm."Membership" = p.source_membership_hint THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    rm.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), target_package AS (
  SELECT mp.name, mp.category
  FROM public.membership_packages mp
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE mp.name = p.target_membership
  ORDER BY mp.display_order NULLS LAST, mp.season DESC, mp.name
  LIMIT 1
), duplicate_queue AS (
  SELECT q.id
  FROM public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items q
  JOIN resolved_batch rb
    ON rb.batch_id = q.batch_id
  JOIN candidate_member cm
    ON cm.raw_member_id = q.raw_member_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE q.target_membership = p.target_membership
    AND q.status IN ('queued', 'exported', 'imported')
  LIMIT 1
), validation AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN rb.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'No processing batch available and no batch_id was provided.'
      WHEN rb.requested_batch_id IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.signup_batches b WHERE b.id = rb.requested_batch_id)
      THEN format('Batch %s does not exist', rb.requested_batch_id)
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_member) THEN 'Member could not be resolved from current raw_members.'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_package) THEN 'Target package is invalid or unavailable.'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target_package tp WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(tp.category), ''), '') = 'Pavilion Key') THEN 'Pavilion Key cannot be queued as a ClubSpark package import target.'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM duplicate_queue) THEN 'This member is already queued for that package in the selected batch.'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS error_message,
    rb.batch_id
  FROM resolved_batch rb
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.signup_batch_clubspark_import_items (
    batch_id,
    raw_member_id,
    member,
    email_address,
    source_membership,
    target_membership,
    status,
    notes,
    created_by
  )
  SELECT
    v.batch_id,
    cm.raw_member_id,
    cm.member_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p.email_address_hint), ''), cm.email_address),
    cm.source_membership,
    p.target_membership,
    'queued',
    NULLIF(trim(p.notes), ''),
    p.created_by
  FROM validation v
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN candidate_member cm
  WHERE v.error_message IS NULL
  RETURNING id, batch_id, member, target_membership, status
)
SELECT
  true AS ok,
  200 AS response_code,
  format('Queued ClubSpark package import item %s in batch %s', id, batch_id) AS message,
  id,
  batch_id,
  member,
  target_membership,
  status
FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  false AS ok,
  400 AS response_code,
  error_message AS message,
  NULL::bigint AS id,
  batch_id,
  NULL::text AS member,
  NULL::text AS target_membership,
  'queued'::text AS status
FROM validation
WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL;`
  }
}];
